categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies socket event handling in src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes an event loop spinning issue where incoming TCP urgent data on POSIX systems leaves socket exceptions pending in select(). Without this change, a peer sending urgent data could trigger a CPU-consuming busy loop in the networking loop.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Minor three-line adjustment in src/util/sock.cpp directly follows from the P2P networking select exception fix rather than serving a general utilities purpose.
categories.rationale: The change to src/util/sock.cpp is ancillary to the P2P connection event loop logic.
